text:
```yaml
name: Auto Assign Milestone

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, closed]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Policy Bot
        uses: dotnet/policy-bot@v1
        with:
          policy-dir: .github/policies
          policy-name: milestoneAssignment
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
